purpose: Investigate timing gaps without robot-control commands

python_receive_compute_audit.limitation: This audits receive delivery and math under current load. It does not exercise RTDE torque submission or establish motion safety.

sdk_source_finding.behavior: If another data-package header is buffered, skip the earlier package before updating robot_state. Getters expose only the latest state.

interpretation: Both receive-only audits reproduced state timestamp gaps with sub-2 ms controller compute and short preallocated logging. The separate native host timer probe was clean. A deliberate queued-packet discard exists in the SDK, but the verbose audit reproduced a 4 ms gap with zero skip messages, so this branch is NOT established as the cause. Latest-state overwrite, read snapshot retry, application scheduling, per-client delivery, network delay and robot output remain candidates. Native language alone is not yet a demonstrated fix.
not_proven: Python excluded as a contributor to polling delay
verification: 46 offline tests passed; no motion verification of the new recording buffer yet

upstream_reporting.distinction: Issue 342 fixes the header offset so deliberate expiry/discard works; 1.6.5 already contains this fix. Strict every-frame logging is a separate acquisition API requirement. No upstream report has been posted.
upstream_reporting.suggestion: Request per-packet snapshots/callbacks or recording mode plus drop counters and documented timing guarantees. Do not claim that removing the skip can restore command deadlines already missed.

run_decision.purpose: Full step-response comparison; preserve the clean OFF capture for strict fitting
run_decision.analysis: Uses observed robot times, flags affected trials/returns, reports actual policy step durations. Missing frames are not reconstructed.
run_decision.controller_timing: Targets advance with received states; a missed frame may extend the preceding torque/policy interval. That deviation is reported rather than treated as nominal 2 ms timing.
run_decision.tests: 52 full-suite tests passed, plus the added sysid-scope guard test and all 12 step tests passed (53 tests total).
run_decision.motion_validation: Pending user-run policy OFF retry2. No control commands sent by diagnostics.
